notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, as the town reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
The Census surveys every government only in Census of Governments years (2022) and a sample in other years, so FY 2023 is the latest available.
Public schools are run by separate school districts, so they are not included. Residents also pay Adams County.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.
Political money is not scored: contributions to Colorado city candidates were not loaded.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.

Cameras: 1 license-plate camera is mapped inside Town of Bennett's borders in OpenStreetMap (1 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. Flock cameras count as a red flag whoever runs them. Other brands count only when the government is the recorded operator, since many have no operator recorded.

Red flags: surveillance programs come from the EFF Atlas of Surveillance, a public database of news reports and public records, searched on 2026-10-18. A town or county with none listed may still have programs nobody has reported. Data center deals and corporate tax breaks have not been checked for Colorado yet. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.

redFlags.label: Flock camera network
redFlags.detail: 1 Flock Safety license-plate camera is mapped inside Town of Bennett's borders in OpenStreetMap. Flock cameras photograph every passing car and feed a search network shared with police agencies across the country. Who runs each camera is not recorded; cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies are not counted.
